stories.headline: Clearlake Capital takes full control of Chelsea
stories.summary: Clearlake Capital has bought out Todd Boehly and Mark Walter's stakes to take full control of the Premier League club Chelsea. The deal values the 25 per cent share at around £950 million. Chelsea is now worth about £5 billion.

stories.headline: Sweden's prime minister resigns after a three-seat defeat
stories.summary: Ulf Kristersson has announced his resignation as Prime Minister of Sweden. His right-wing bloc won 173 seats in the Riksdag, against 176 for the opposition led by Magdalena Andersson.

stories.headline: Americana awards return to the Ryman for a 25th year
stories.summary: The Americana Music Honors & Awards were held at the Ryman Auditorium in Nashville, Tennessee. It was the 25th edition of the ceremony, which began in 2002. The Heartbreakers performed for the first time since 2017.

stories.headline: The first new cat species in over a century
stories.summary: Biologists have named a new species of wild cat from Bolivia, the tilcayo tiger cat, which first became known to science in 2026. It is the first member of the cat family to be formally identified in over a century, after the Chinese mountain cat in 1892. It was found in the Yungas forest region, a cloud forest on the eastern slope of the Andes.
